arms.whole: the whole change at the bridge word (45m's whole arm, rerun)
arms.a1: (1) the base edit: the whole change minus its J++ part (k = 25, signed), at the bridge word
arms.a2: (2) the base edit, and the new item's token(s) in its locker sentence without their own J++ part
arms.a3: (3) the base edit, and the same tokens without a random part of the same share
arms.a4: (4) the base edit, and the control item's token(s) without their own J++ part
arms.o2: O alone with (2)'s item edit (no base edit)

random_part: X0's random subspace, seed 888 + layer, at each token's J++ share of ||h||^2
items_rule: the 45m run's items at L (chat) whose new item's (alt) locker sentence comes before the asked pick (x0_strata); O and S the same but for the bridge word; a control locker item; every patched token exactly its item's name; else dropped and counted
positions: the tokens overlapping the item's name inside its locker sentence (character offsets of the rendered prompt); control: the first locker sentence in context order whose item is neither the bridge nor the new item
h: O's clean state at L (an edit at L changes only its own positions' states at L)
read: X0's chat read: the prompt with a digit's space token appended; switch = top token is S's answer; right = top token is O's
rule: the recall reads the earlier mention if the recall's switch loss in (2) exceeds (3) by at least 0.2 and (4) by at least 0.15 (loss_k = 1 - S_k / S_1, point estimates), on at least 2 of 3 models; a model whose base edit switches fewer than 30 recalls is not tested
